_meta.purpose: Four-input sourcing evidence for 5 new city corridors (DiDi Mexico +2, inDrive Egypt +3). Jaideep instruction 2026-07-22: source demand ourselves and add these cities to the decks.
_meta.four_input_rule: named pier-to-pier route + distance(nm) + benchmarked premium fare($/seat OW) + anchored demand(labeled). Fail closed otherwise.
_meta.fare_method: premium-substitute benchmarking (Uber Black equivalent), Jaideep override Jul 2026; consistent with confirmed MX anchors ($30 Playa-Cozumel, $20 Huatulco, $12 Holbox).

didi_mexico.demand_basis: Yelapa is road-inaccessible — 100% boat access (captive). Anchored bottoms-up on the published scheduled Los Muertos–Yelapa co-op service (5 daily OW departures 11:00/11:45/13:00/15:00/17:00, 20-pax pangas, ~60% load), a conservative floor that EXCLUDES the larger Boca de Tomatlán departure point, private charters and tour traffic. PV metro received 6.27M visitors in 2025.

didi_mexico.corridor: Cabo San Lucas Marina → Puerto Los Cabos (San José del Cabo)
didi_mexico.dest_terminal: Puerto Los Cabos Marina (San José del Cabo)
didi_mexico.demand_anchor: 3.86M Los Cabos visitors/yr; 257,000 Cabo San Lucas marina cruise pax/yr (2024)
didi_mexico.demand_basis: Los Cabos destination welcomed a record 3.86M travelers (2023); Cabo San Lucas marina handled 257,000+ cruise passengers in 2024. The two towns are linked by the ~33km Tourist Corridor; corridor demand anchored on this resort-corridor visitor base (premium inter-town transfer, no scheduled ferry today).
sources: fiturca.com Los Cabos Tourism Observatory Oct24 (42.2K cruise pax Aug-24)

indrive_egypt.demand_basis: Nile Taxi (NTS) operates exactly this Zamalek–Maadi commuter route today with 10 boats (120-seat capacity), serving ~180,000 clients/year. Current Nile Taxi Zamalek→Maadi OW fare already ~US$21 (Bookaway), so a $20 premium-seat benchmark is grounded on an operating market. 12km/8mi apart; river routing ~7nm.
sources: Nile Taxi official (Instagram: 10 boats/120 seats, ~180,000 clients/yr Maadi-Zamalek)

indrive_egypt.demand_basis: El Gouna (single master-developer resort town, Orascom) welcomes over 1 million visitors annually and has 25,000+ full-time residents across 50+ nationalities. Corridor connects El Gouna's Abu Tig Marina to the sourced Hurghada Marina 25km south. Premium Red Sea intercity speedboat-transfer market: shared transfer ~€10–25, private €75+; $25 premium-seat benchmark.
sources: El Gouna/Safaga speedboat transfer market pricing

indrive_egypt.corridor: Port Ghalib Marina → Sha'ab Samadai (Dolphin House)
indrive_egypt.demand_anchor: ~1.09M Marsa Alam air arrivals/yr; Samadai managed reef-excursion program
indrive_egypt.demand_basis: Marsa Alam International Airport handled ~1.09M passengers/yr (record-breaking growth, +24% YoY). Port Ghalib is the marina gateway to the Samadai 'Dolphin House' protected reef, which runs a managed daily-visitor program (historically capped ~200/day, previously 500–800/day). Reef-excursion market supports €70–165 full-day trips, so $30 premium-seat OW is conservative.
sources: airserviceone.com Marsa Alam record growth (+24% YoY)
